newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - Fraser-AMMB says buy Flextech.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Fraser-AMMB says buy Flextech.

text.p: Fraser-AMMB Research has called a buy on electronics and industrial distributor Flextech Holdings.
In a note on Tuesday, it said Flextech's recent acquisition of two business units of Texas Instruments (TI) would impact its earnings positively.
"The acquisitons will impact positively on the group's earnings starting from the current year," it said.

The latest acquisitions would enable Flextech to tap opportunities in the dynamic semiconductor equipment market, and was in line with the group's overall strategy to diversify from its core distribution business, Fraser-AMBB said.
- Quality Assurance Solutions Division (QAS) which designs and develops high speed vision systems and are used to inspect integrated circuits packages, and
- Laser and Vision Division under Singapore Process Automation Centre (SPAC) which develops a wide range of laser marking equipment and vision inspection engines.
The move gives Flextech broader exposure to semiconductor back-end processes to include finishing processes, Fraser-AMMB said.

It said Flextech has estimated turnover contribution from the two units in the second half of the fiscal year ending December 1997 to be about Singapore $10-12 million. Gross margin and net profit margin are expected to be in excess of 30 percent and 10 percent respectively.
Fraser-AMMB said it expected Flextech's earnings in the current year to be significantly better than last year.

"The core distribution business should grow about 15 percent over FY96. Sales of tape and reel machines and services, affected by industry slowdown in the later half of 1996, are expected to improve in the current year in line with the gradual recovery of the semiconductor industry," it said.
"The macro outlook for the new businesses is also favourable. With new semiconductor plants being built in Asia, capital spending is expected to top US$27 billion by year 2000," it said.
